prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Tyler TX?
answer_verbatim:
I don’t have live web access from here, so I can’t look up current review rankings — but I can help you find the best tanning salon in Tyler quickly. A lot depends on what you want. Quick questions first:

- Do you want spray (sunless) tanning, UV tanning beds, or both?
- What part of Tyler are you near (zip code or neighborhood)?
- Is price, convenience (hours/location), or safety/cleanliness most important?

How to pick the best salon (quick checklist)
- Services: make sure they offer the type you want (spray vs UV). If spray, ask what solution/brand they use and whether they do custom color/mist or airbrush.
- Cleanliness and maintenance: beds, booths, and common areas should be clean; technicians should wear gloves for spray tans.
- Staff training: technicians should offer a pre-tan consultation and patch tests for spray tans.
- Equipment: for UV tanning, newer high-pressure beds give more even, faster results and are easier on the skin. For spray, look for airbrush or automated booths with good reviews.
- Safety practices: eye protection, clear instructions on pre/post-tan care, skin type assessment, and frequency guidance.
- Reviews: check Google, Yelp, Facebook for recent ratings and before/after photos.
- Pricing and packages: compare single sessions vs packages/memberships; watch for expiration dates and cancellation policies.
- Hygiene & ventilation: booths should be well-vented; staff should change liners or sanitize between clients.

Where to look (fast)
- Google Maps and Yelp for top-rated nearby salons and recent photos
- Instagram or Facebook pages for before/after photos
- Groupon for deals (but read reviews first)
- Call the salon and ask about technician experience, products used, and their safety/cleaning practices

If you want, give me your ZIP code or neighborhood and whether you want spray or UV and I’ll list the top-rated salons in Tyler (based on the latest available public listings) and what to ask when you call.
